title: Cyrus Sinclair and Bass Edwards
summary: He knew Cyrus Sinclair from Small's but never worked with him or with tuba player Bass Edwards.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Did you ever play with Cyrus Sinclair?
Did I ever work with him?
No. But I knew him from being down at Smalls. He was down there with Charlie Johnson. I knew him from when I'd sit in to try and work with Charlie Johnson's
band -- I knew him from there.
And then there was Bass Edwards. He was another good tuba player.

Yeah. But I never worked with Bass Edwards nowhere. Nowhere at all. Everybody always told me how good he was, but I didn't see him getting any work. I guess he worked. But you know, he was a little ahead of my time.
